based_on: Skool public help center and pricing pages
meta.product_positioning: Private, paid community platform inspired by Skool, redesigned for privacy-first creators, institutions, and research communities.
meta.design_goal: Make community monetization feel simple, trustworthy, premium, and low-friction while preserving membership privacy.

core_principles: Privacy is the hero, not a hidden setting.
Reduce creator workload: fewer clicks, clearer states, stronger defaults.
Show aggregate analytics only; never expose member lists or wallet-level detail.
Every page must answer: what can I do now, what is private, and what happens next?
Skool-like simplicity, but with more professional credibility for institutions and research groups.
Fast onboarding: public pages for discovery, wallet-gated actions only when necessary.
Design for dark mode first, with neutral professional styling instead of meme-heavy crypto aesthetics.

primary_personas.name: Subscriber / analyst / student
needs: Retrieve gated content across web and Telegram

layout.desktop: Left sidebar + top utility bar + main content column + contextual right panel when needed
layout.mobile: Bottom nav for members; drawer nav for creators

interaction_rules: Keep destructive actions separated from primary workflow.
Always show loading, success, failure, and empty states.
Always explain privacy-sensitive actions with inline microcopy.
Avoid exposing blockchain jargon first; progressive disclosure only.

page_flows.name: Landing Page
page_flows.goal: Convert visitors into creators or members while explaining why Sorts is different from Skool-like community platforms.
ux_notes: Hero must explain private memberships in one sentence.
Show aggregate metrics examples, not fake member avatars.
Replace social-proof vanity counters with trust artifacts: chain, token standard, encryption model, real workflow.

states.not_connected: Show connect wallet only when user picks a gated action

page_flows.name: Discovery
page_flows.goal: Help users browse communities by theme without exposing private member identity.
ux_notes: Discovery should rank quality, engagement, and retention signals at the community level, never member-level identity.
Show category, description, posting cadence, content format, pricing floor, and privacy level.

page_flows.name: Create Community
page_flows.goal: Launch a community in one guided flow.
fields: tiers[]: name, price_eth, duration_days, benefits, visibility_label
ux_notes: Use a stepper wizard, not one huge form.
Default to 3 tiers with editable templates: Basic, Pro, VIP.
Show live pricing summary and estimated member-facing display.

page_flows.name: Creator Dashboard
page_flows.goal: Give creators a clean command center across communities.
ux_notes: Never show subscriber list.
Cards should show total members, active ratio, revenue, latest content published, last sync status.

page_flows.name: Community Overview
page_flows.goal: Provide privacy-safe analytics and operational status.
ux_notes: Use aggregate numbers only.
Show active vs expired memberships, not who expired.
Add privacy notice: 'Individual members are intentionally hidden.'

page_flows.name: Content Management
page_flows.goal: Let creators publish and organize gated posts like a simpler, more professional Skool classroom + feed hybrid.
ux_notes: Default editor should be distraction-free.
Tier selector must be visually obvious.
Show what each tier can access without exposing who accessed it.

page_flows.name: Access Control
page_flows.goal: Manage how privacy, expiry, and delivery work.
ux_notes: Do not expose wallet addresses in verification logs.
Show only counts, failure categories, and latest system events.

page_flows.name: Billing and Revenue
page_flows.goal: Let creators manage prices and inspect aggregate revenue safely.
ux_notes: Hide individual payer identity by default.
Institution mode should support monthly exports and cleaner finance-oriented layout.

page_flows.name: Join / Subscribe Page
page_flows.goal: Convert interested visitors into members with minimal friction.
ux_notes: Do not force wallet connection before showing value proposition.
Make privacy benefit explicit near pricing.
Support renewal and expired membership recovery on the same page.

page_flows.name: Member Community Feed
page_flows.goal: Provide a clean home for gated content consumption and member participation.
ux_notes: Resemble a high-quality community feed, not a noisy social network.
Pinned 'How this community works' module should appear for new members.
If membership expired, replace feed with renewal state; do not tease inaccessible content excessively.

page_flows.name: Library / Classroom
page_flows.goal: Organize durable knowledge better than Skool for research and institutional use.
ux_notes: Support both course-style progression and research-library browsing.
Add metadata for type, freshness, author role, tier required, and estimated reading time.

page_flows.name: Events
page_flows.goal: Make calls, research briefings, and office hours discoverable without clutter.
ux_notes: Institution mode favors agenda, speaker, and materials over gamified visuals.
Show event access tier and whether recording will be available.

page_flows.name: Wallet ↔ Telegram Linking
page_flows.goal: Connect Telegram identity to wallet with maximum trust and minimum confusion.
ux_notes: Use a wizard with clear progress states.
Explain that signature proves ownership and does not move funds.

institution_mode.description: A presentation and layout layer optimized for research institutes, DAOs, and analyst teams.

creator_mode.description: Default mode for independent creators and paid communities.

key_user_flows.name: Renewal flow
steps: Hit expired state on feed or join page

color_direction.accent: electric blue or teal used sparingly

microcopy_guidelines: Say 'link Telegram securely' before saying 'EIP-712 signature'.
Avoid aggressive crypto slang in default UI.
anti_patterns: Do not show public member avatar walls.
Do not expose wallet addresses in tables or activity feeds.
Do not overuse neon cyberpunk visuals.
Do not require wallet connection just to browse basic community information.
Do not mix creator actions and member actions on the same primary screen.

recommended_stack: sqlite/prisma or drizzle for MVP backend
React Query or server actions for data flows
deliverables: No fake personal member data in UI mocks
